title: Porch Pro Reviews: Is Porch Worth It for Contractors?

facts.fact: The Townsquare Interactive article 'Porch Pro Reviews: Is Porch Worth It for Contractors?' is shown on the page as published March 1, 2022.
The page's embedded metadata lists a published time of 21 November 2019, which conflicts with the visible March 1, 2022 date.
According to the article, Porch is classified as a pay-per-lead company similar to Angi and Home Advisor.
facts.quote: Porch is similar to other pay-per-lead companies, such as Angi and Home Advisor.

facts.fact: According to the article, Porch has a partnership with Lowe's.
facts.quote: One of Porch’s main draws is its partnership with Lowe’s

facts.fact: Per the article, Porch has homeowners enter a timeline and budget for the project they need a pro for.
facts.quote: It has homeowners enter a timeline and budget for the project they need a pro for.

facts.fact: Per the article, when a homeowner submits a Porch request, multiple pros in the area are alerted, so contractors race to get the lead first.
facts.quote: Upon submission, multiple pros in the area are alerted, which means contractors are now in a race to get the lead first.

facts.fact: The article states that Porch lead generation is portrayed as inconsistent in many Porch Pro reviews, a characterization by the author rather than measured data.
facts.quote: Porch lead generation is portrayed as inconsistent in many Porch Pro reviews
